description: He wears a long forest-green wool tunic with gold knotwork borders at the neckline, down the front, around the cuffs and at the hem. Cream linen underlayers show at the collar, sleeve ends and below the tunic. A broad green cloak with matching gold knotwork edging and fringe drapes over the shoulders and one side, secured by a round ornate gold brooch. A wide brown leather belt carries decorated round gold plaques and a long hanging tail with a medallion and pointed metal end. Brown trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots with crossing straps.
